# Ramouz Café

> Specialty coffee café on the Muscat waterfront, Oman — beans roasted in-house, fresh bakery, and desserts.

Ramouz Café is a specialty coffee shop in Muscat, Oman. We import and roast our own beans, bake everything in-house, and serve coffee, tea and matcha, cold and refreshing drinks, bites, and fit options. Prices are in Omani Rial (OMR).

## Details
- Location: Muscat, Oman
- Phone: +968 7844 9000
- Hours: Sun–Wed 6:30 AM–12:30 AM; Thu 6:30 AM–1:30 AM; Fri 8:00 AM–1:30 AM; Sat 8:00 AM–12:30 AM
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/ramouz_oman

- [Full menu](https://amirhj2007.github.io/ramouz-website/#menu): 85 items across Coffee Base, Tea & Matcha, Cold & Refreshing, Bites, and Fit. Full machine-readable menu (names, sections, descriptions, prices) is embedded on the homepage as Schema.org Menu structured data.
